description: Simulate a simple buy ladder on Bitvavo BTC-EUR daily candles since 2019: buy a slice on every step_pct drop below the lowest open buy, sell each slice at +target_pct, never at a loss. Returns realized %, trades, open positions at the end and buy-and-hold for comparison.

start_date.description: Default: one year before the last candle.

name: simulate_ladder
title: Grid / buy-ladder simulation on real BTC-EUR prices
